featured_reviews.name: Minoti Merchant
featured_reviews.review_text: I came across Dnceall on instagram a few months ago and kept following their videos and fitness programs. It was just over 2 months that I finally decided to try out a session and see if I can manage their workouts. I have a history of a brain surgery which has reduced my stamina drastically and lack of physical exercise in last 7 years due to it has made my body stiff. The problem child in me also has osteoarthritis hence squats and jumps are tough to manage with knee pain. And I am also on hormone replacement therapy which keeps adding weight. So I am swimming against the flowing river water.... yet Dnceall fitness programme has started making a difference in how my body feels. My main aim was not to lose weight but to get fit, increase my stamina and get my stiff body to become flexible. And I can surely feel that happening. During the first two weeks, I used to be exhausted and dead after the workouts with bodyache lingering into the next session. But now I feel more energized. What used to be unbearable pain, now seems a bit bearable.... and that truly gives me hope. Hope... that I can get back to the fitness levels of what I was before my surgery. Tishya, Abhinav and Vidula are really great teachers, who let you work as per your limits yet inspire you with their enthusiasm and make you want to push yourself. Its been a fun few weeks and I know I still have a long way to go but I am glad I am on the right path with Dnceall.... which is actually a perfect name... Dance for all!!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dance for all - YESSSS
That was always the intention because we feel like everybody can dance, in big or small ways. The bigger idea is to stay motivated and have fun!
So so so glad to hear that you're progressing in the right direction. May you get stronger than ever before, cheers to more dances with you ✨🌻

The lack of transparency about these policies upfront is disappointing. Had I known about them, I would have considered whether to sign up in the first place. featured_reviews.name: Shankho Bag
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have had the pleasure of learning Salsa at Baile-De-Salon for almost a year and have really been mesmerized by the professionalism and talent on display.
Classes are on convenient times during the weekends and the instructors are accommodative in case you miss a class.
As for the dance itself, it is led by Ajaz and Maneka who are highly skilled and have been teaching this art form for almost 15 years. They can clearly communicate the concepts and combos to the students, while also providing individual attention to those who need it (like me). The combos are challenging but achievable. They also ensure the students get a flavor of Latin American culture by orchestrating Rueda (Cuban form of Garba) at regular intervals.
Apart from the top-notch instruction, I was also impressed by the diversity of the students. There were dancers of all ages and skill levels, and the instructors foster a welcoming and an inclusive environment. As someone who has never danced before, it was an easy decision for me to continue the classes in such an environment.
Overall, I highly recommend Baile-De-Salon to anyone looking to pick up a new skill or simply have a fun and enjoyable workout. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced dancer, there is something for everyone in this fantastic studio.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Team TDAS

The entire team is incredible.
Nritya 6 was a big hit. We have witnessed previous shows but every year it gets better and better.
This is because of the hard work and efforts you all put in day and night. From selecting the songs to editing them, from choreographing to training the students, from short listing the materials to designing to getting all the costumes stitched in time and most importantly from stage rehearsal Checks to final performances, everything your team does is upto perfection.
What the audience sees on stage must be just a 2 -3 minutes performance, but the efforts behind every single performance are of more than 20 hours. But in the end it is all worth with the crazy shout outs from the audiences.
I don’t know how do you all manage everything and still keeping your cool and patience with each and every performer. Each and every faculty at the institute is so patient with the students, be it with small kids or us adults. The love, care and comfort you all give them is just incredible, which, when we parents leave our kids with you all, we are never worried about them, because we know they are in very safe hands.
My daughter was being trained by Swathi mam. The change I have seen in her in this entire year is amazing. She has groomed and improved so much, it is all because of her patience amazing dancing skills and super amazing teaching skill. Thank you mam.
My journey throughout the year has been with Priyanka mam has been so amazing that I can’t describe in words, still shall try to brief it. She is an amazing person, very soft at heart and most importantly very patient with us. We must have eaten up her head and we have also been very naughty at times, but she has always been there to help us, handle us and our tantrums, support us and over all deal with us 😂. Thank you mam you are a wonderful person inside out.

Congratulations
Shweta mam, Shraddha mam, Maitri mam, Priyanka mam, Swathi mam, Niyati mam, Avisha mam, Diya mam, Shubham sir and also Venkatesh - on the great success of this beautiful event which has marked a special place in everyone’s hearts.
Cheers to team TDAS, proud to be a part of this.

Lots of love - Heya and Nisha
